name: Planning
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of thoughtful planning grounded in wisdom and reliance on God. The Proverbs highlight the value of seeking counsel and preparing carefully, as plans without guidance often fail, but many advisers bring safety and success. Believers are encouraged to commit their works to the Lord, trusting that He will establish their thoughts and direct their steps, recognizing that human intentions must align with divine guidance to avoid folly and sin.
